files.description: Moyae's ONC mandatory disclosures and costs page. Contains certification info, EHI export format statement ('New-line delimited JSON export of FHIR data'), costs disclosures, and links to Real World Testing plans. The only EHI-specific content is the single-line export format description.

Complete Postman collection for the Moyae FHIR API. Contains 954 endpoints across 122 folders covering 118 FHIR resource types, plus Authentication, Export ($export system-level bulk data), CCDA, MFA, and metadata endpoints. No example response bodies included. This is the primary EHI export API documentation.

FHIR R4 CapabilityStatement from Moyae's live FHIR server. Lists 146 supported resource types with full CRUD + search interactions, search parameters for each resource, OAuth2 security configuration, and a system-level $export operation (Bulk Data). Publisher: Moyae, FHIR version: 4.0.1.

SMART on FHIR configuration document. Contains OAuth2 endpoints (Auth0-based: auth.moyae-dev.com) and supported SMART capabilities including launch-ehr, launch-standalone, permission-patient, permission-user, and sso-openid-connect.

Enrichment output: structured JSON summary of the Postman API collection. Contains 122 folders, 954 total endpoints, 118 resource type folders, export endpoints, and per-folder endpoint details.
